## Peer-reviewed research

My research includes work on agricultural risk management, forward contracting, crop insurance, producer decision-making, production risk, and agricultural policy.

## Extension & policy outreach

### How Can Crop Marketing and Crop Insurance Go Together?

Coauthored extension article published by **Southern Ag Today**. The article was recognized as the **Top Wednesday Article for May 2025–April 2026**.

I have also contributed to extension and policy work on ARC-CO and PLC payments for major U.S. crops.
